purpose: Deterministically remove the plain background and faint contact shadow from the exact owner-selected rounded Wizard source, then place it without repainting or non-uniform distortion.

matte.post_resample_component_selection: retain the largest 8-connected nonzero-alpha component after each resize to suppress isolated bicubic ringing pixels
matte.enclosed_holes: fill as opaque above source y=900 to retain eyes, yarn highlights, and other source-internal near-white pixels; discard lower enclosed regions because they belong to the contact-shadow zone
matte.external_background: discard, including disconnected and border-connected pixels
matte.contact_shadow: discard unless a source pixel lies within the three-pixel soft edge of the selected hard subject
matte.edge_color: uncomposite soft-edge RGB from the fixed white matte using the computed alpha; hard foreground and enclosed holes retain exact source RGB

source_landmarks.method: reviewed source-pixel landmarks: ground root between the two feet and visible center of the image-right upward-facing palm cradle

superseded_b1_socket.status: amended for the owner-approved rounded B2G anatomy
superseded_b1_socket.reason: Matching the old socket and baseline would require scale about 0.3305, leaving the 898-pixel-tall shadow-free subject only about 297 pixels tall. The full-height uniform placement below preserves the selected character and moves metadata to the visible palm.

resampling.alpha: premultiplied during filtering, straight RGBA in PNG
resampling.png: 8-bit non-interlaced RGBA, filter type 0, deterministic zlib level 9
